dataset.name: LHMC stage I LUAD validation cohort (GSE273377)
dataset.description: Independent stage I lung adenocarcinoma validation cohort with bulk exome-capture RNA sequencing and individual seven-year recurrence-free survival.
dataset.cohort_context: The source study independently validated its vascular-invasion program in resected stage I lung adenocarcinomas from Lahey Hospital and Medical Center. Sixty RNA profiles passed source QC. They represent 59 patients because one patient contributed two tumor profiles; TRACE Explorer retains the profile with the higher transcript-integrity number. One patient lacks individual RFS and one has time zero, leaving 57 endpoint-complete patients. The discovery cohort is registered separately and is never pooled with this dataset.

metadata.source_program: LHMC stage I LUAD vascular-invasion validation study
metadata.source_data_system: NCBI Gene Expression Omnibus and Nature Communications source data
metadata.library_method: Exome-targeted bulk RNA-seq from FFPE resection tissue using Illumina TruSeq RNA Exome libraries and paired-end 75-nucleotide reads
metadata.endpoint_context: Source-defined seven-year recurrence-free survival after surgical resection
metadata.endpoint_caveat: The source data provide individual follow-up capped at 84 months and a binary RFS event field. The cohort has only six events, so adjusted and nonlinear models require explicit sparse-data diagnostics.
metadata.sample_selection_note: Only samples labeled validation cohort and passed qc: TRUE are eligible. Patient 1231 has two endpoint-identical profiles; the higher mean transcript-integrity number is selected deterministically before endpoint QC.
metadata.clinical_evidence_note: The pinned CC BY source-data ZIP contains 59 validation RNA records with individual RFS. Fifty-nine GEO titles link exactly; one additional passed-QC GEO profile has no individual endpoint. A time-zero censored record is excluded under the repository-wide positive-time rule.
metadata.overlap_note: The validation and discovery cohorts are independent source cohorts. They are exposed as separate datasets, and neither includes TCGA-LUAD, Uppsala GSE81089 or TRACERx samples used elsewhere in the publication.
metadata.redistribution_note: TRACE Explorer downloads and transforms the public GEO and CC BY source files in place. Redistribution of the source expression matrix remains disabled under the conservative repository policy.

samples.sample_role: Resected stage I lung adenocarcinoma FFPE tumor from the independent validation cohort

expression.label: GEO RSEM counts normalized to log2(CPM + 1)
expression.mapping_source: Pinned Ensembl release 108 GRCh38 annotation declared by the source study
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: Symbols mapped from more than one source Ensembl row are excluded rather than combined without an unambiguous source-level rule.
expression.scale_note: TRACE Explorer computes sample library sizes across all 62,703 pinned RSEM count rows, converts counts to CPM and applies log2(CPM + 1). It does not apply the source study's downstream ComBat-seq correction, avoiding leakage of source-defined comparison groups into a general-purpose survival layer.

endpoints.label: Seven-year recurrence-free survival
endpoints.event_definition: Recurrence event as encoded in the source seven-year RFS field
